levels.name: Recognise
levels.evidence: Learner can identify fibres and yarn in the chapter context.

levels.name: Explain
levels.evidence: Learner can explain fibres and yarn and connect it to weaving and fabric without copying source wording.

levels.name: Apply
levels.evidence: Learner can use warp and weft in a familiar new situation.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.evidence: Learner can solve or explain an unfamiliar situation using several ideas from Clothes — How Things are Made and justify the response.

levels.name: Create
levels.evidence: Learner can create a new example, question, model, investigation or explanation based on Clothes — How Things are Made.

progressionRule: Move upward only when the learner demonstrates the current level independently and can explain the reasoning.
